Only profile metadata adds helper inputs and invariant TLS/mode facts. No compiled source/helper/flags/binary changed. Canonical generic parser/fingerprint verification uses final configuration.

method: 15 warmups,105 samples in seven rotated/reversed orders,15 separate allocation loops per host. Hot parent046f195a transport/public header reconstructed from Git objects, substituted at same object-list position; current Core/dependencies shared. Updated TLS feature off/on uses same fixture and exact reply bytes. Engine2, one connection, default shared Server,7B/16KiB, single call/barrier window32. Explicit TLS13/cipher/nonresumed checks precede timed hot samples. Cold100 serial complete peer cycles with numeric/prepared/OS localhost routing, app DNS cache disabled, exact reply+TLS13/nonresumed/ALPN/verifier-count validation included in interval. Native record/ciphertext copies included; hot handshake and host construction/final joins excluded. CPU is all process threads. Counts, commands, metrics and binaries preserved.
timing_limitations: All runs unpinned and other workloads uncontrolled; Windows snapshot observed two other compiler processes and36 percent host load. Closed-loop tails have coordinated omission, barrier-window32 has no per-call latency distribution. Large hot samples512 and cold samples100 make P99.9 the observed maximum; no extreme-tail gate. Full range/median <5 percent throughput and <10 percent P99 are screening qualifiers, stricter than just comparing medians. Windows16KiB/window1 is the only hot configuration where all three rates qualify; its median rates meet5 percent bound, P99 does not qualify. Other hot rate/P99 comparisons are inconclusive, never promoted to green.
cpu_limitations: Some original short Windows loops report zero or coarse CPU values due observed GetProcessTimes quantization. Do not treat zeros as zero cost or use those values for CPU acceptance. Twelve additional longer, uninstrumented batches per host each observe >100ms process CPU, with counts32768/262144/8192/32768 for small-w1/small-w32/large-w1/large-w32. One observation per profile, resolution calibration only; no qualified CPU regression conclusion. Original timing/heap observations retained unchanged.
allocation_limitations: Heap metrics are XRT tracked block allocation traffic; exclude host construction, libc latency arrays and kernel/other-process allocations. Most corresponding hot counts match, some window samples differ; no zero-extra-allocation claim or unverified attribution. No copy/synchronization/syscall counter coverage in this slice.

performance.scope: 135 executions:15 warmups,seven rotated samples per15 profiles,15 separate heap loops. Hot numeric TLS: parent046f195a matching transport source+public header, updated feature off/on; same current Core/dependency objects, parent object substituted at same link position; exact byte validation, explicit full TLS13 checked outside steady samples,7B/16KiB and windows1/32. TLS native record/ciphertext copies included, handshake outside hot loop. Cold: full numeric/prepared/OS localhost DNS peer lifecycle, app DNS cache off, TLS13 nonresumed/ALPN/verifier count and reply bytes checked in timed loop,100 serial cycles, all process-thread CPU. Closed-loop tails have coordinated omission, P999 at100 cycles is a sample maximum. Unpinned, no noise retries; spread qualification <5% rate/<10% P99 is screening only. No fixed-arrival/connection-scale/native Linux/72h acceptance.

cpu_calibration.scope: Twelve separate longer uninstrumented timing batches. Short Windows samples hit GetProcessTimes quantization, including zero. These longer batches each observe >100ms process CPU, preserve exact byte/TLS verification, include all process threads and exclude warmup/handshake. One observation per profile: resolution calibration, no noise qualification, and never replaces seven-sample throughput/tail results. Allocation stats are disabled.
